input.summary: Single root cause: apply_discount computes the discount amount instead of the discounted price; cart_total is fixed through it.

subtasks.title: Fix inverted discount in apply_discount
subtasks.description: In shop/pricing.py, apply_discount(price, percent) returns price * percent / 100. It must return price * (1 - percent / 100), rounded to cents, keeping the percent range validation. cart_total calls it, so no change is needed there. Verify with tests/test_pricing.py.

worker.text: Root cause is the return expression in apply_discount; fixing it there also fixes cart_total.

input.summary: apply_discount now returns the discounted price (price * (1 - percent/100)); cart_total is correct through it. Full suite passes.
